requirement.evidence: The Ellis Implementation Ordinance requires the same relocation assistance payments for tenants evicted so the owner can remove a property from the rental housing market.
requirement.note: Amounts of $19,413 and $6,471 effective January 1, 2026 are stated in the document.

key_value.evidence:
The standard relocation assistance payment will increase to
$19,413
.
key_value.note: The additional $6,471 for qualifying households is also stated in the document.

effective_date.evidence: At its October 16, 2025 Special Meeting, the Rent Board approved relocation assistance payment increases that will go into effect on January 1, 2026.

status.evidence: Annual increases for owner move-in and Ellis Act eviction relocation assistance payments go into effect January 1, 2026.
status.note: As of 2026-10-01 the date has passed, and the document presents the amounts as current.
